test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. Robert waited for his brother to leave.

B. He climbed in and then just sat there thinking.

C. His thoughts were totally focused on his brother.

D. Then he quickly made his way to his truck.
solution:
The correct answer is **'ADBC'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• While reading all the sentences, we get to know that there is **one character named Robert who finally caught the truck after waiting long for his brother.**

 
 
• The **first sentence **normally talks about the main character, that is **(A) **- ***Robert waited for his brother to leave.***
 
• The **second sentence **is narrating what he did, that is **(D) - *Then he quickly made his way to his truck.***
 
• The **third sentence **explains the next step taken by him, that is **(B) - *****He climbed in and then just sat there thinking.***
 
• Now we are left with the **fourth sentence,** that is **(C) - *****His thoughts were totally focused on his brother.***
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the **meaning of words in the sentences.**

 
• **Climb **- *to go up or to the top of something.*
 
• **Make a way **- to move forward usually by following a path.*
